content: The SOME/IP TP module shall compare the value of the Offset Field with the sum divided by 16 of copied Payload bytes since the first received SOME/IP segment (i.e. with Offset Field set to '0'). If this sum divided by 16 matches with the current Offset Value and if the bufferSize Ptr provided by the previous call of the API PduR_SomeIpTpCopyRxData()is greater or equal to the received payload, call the API PduR_SomeIpTpCopyRxData()with Sdu Length set to the received Payload bytes.
